name: trivy
title: Trivy
description: Aqua Trivy — multi-target vulnerability and misconfiguration scanner. Pick the mode with TRIVY_SCAN_TYPE (fs / image / repo / config / k8s) and pass the corresponding target in TRIVY_TARGET (a directory, image reference, repo URL, IaC dir, or cluster name). TRIVY_SEVERITY filters by severity (CSV, e.g. HIGH,CRITICAL); TRIVY_IGNORE_UNFIXED=true hides vulnerabilities without an upstream fix.
